title: Rezoning to allow housing at 862-868 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This land use application would change the zoning map for 862-868 Kent Avenue in Brooklyn from an M1-1 manufacturing district to an M1-4/R6A district and create a Special Mixed Use District. The change would allow a mix of residential and manufacturing uses on the site. The site is in Brooklyn Community District 3 and Council District 33.
